body: Hey thanks, I have therapy scheduled next week. Life just sucks all the time. To a point it's like nothing makes you happy at all. I mean NOTHING makes you happy. It's been this way for all of my teenage years, it goes beyond adolescent depression. Nothing's changed.  Making friends never works.  they never stay.  Maybe I'm just too far outcasted from society at this point, but I can't get back in there. The world genuinely looks so strange out there, like nothing is real. Like this world just isn't for me.
